Sierra Estrella lies 29 km away at 207°, 21° from the line to the flares 82 km away.
The ridge point used is off the line of sight; where the ridge crosses that line its height may differ, so the altitudes below are indicative.
Flares there are visible above the ridge only while higher than about 3,023–3,560 m (9,918–11,680 ft); below that they would vanish behind it.
The drop altitude isn't stated in the sources, so whether they cleared the ridge isn't tested.
